messages:
ashley: rolling a small canary for lyric7b-int4 to validate quant and defaults. seeing OOMs on a few requests when max_new_tokens=512 and batch=4. KV allocation spikes around generation start — anyone seen this with lyric variants?

matt: saw something similar on a different quant build. often fragmentation + aggressive prefetch causes it. quick mitigations: lower max_new_tokens default for canary, reduce batch, and drop prefetch window. try batch=2 + max_new_tokens=256 first.

sana: agreed. also add a runtime fallback to fp16 for high mem pressure so customer traffic doesn't hard fail. we can route to lyric7b-fp16 when mem_util > 0.8. patch below for canary config I tested locally:

```
canary_config:
  model: lyric7b-int4
  batch_size: 2
  max_new_tokens: 256
  prefetch_window: 1
  kv_evict_threshold: 0.75
  fallback_model: lyric7b-fp16
```

ashley: thanks, applied that to the canary pool and kicked a few smoke runs. devops-bot kicked the deployment:

devops-bot: deploy canary lyric7b-int4 -> pool: canary-2, revision: r2026-03-20-11

ashley: smoke results: 7/10 requests ok, 3/10 OOM even with batch=2. logs show repeated fragments rather than single big alloc:

```
[2026-03-20T11:05:12Z] ERROR oom_alloc: failed to allocate 24MB
[2026-03-20T11:05:12Z] WARN mem_frag: free_list_ratio=0.64, kv_chunks=512
[2026-03-20T11:05:12Z] INFO fallback: triggering fallback policy? no
```

matt: that log line screams fragmentation. couple options: (1) runtime compact after each response (cheap but adds small CPU), (2) reduce prefetch memory reservation, (3) bump kv_evict_threshold lower so eviction happens earlier. I can try a runtime toggle that compacts KV cache at end-of-turn — will push as a hotfix to canary. Also add routing policy change: fallback to fp16 if mem_util > 0.8 or free_list_ratio < 0.6.

matt: CMD to apply quick toggle for canary: `rbctl rollout --pool canary-2 --patch runtime.kv_compact=true`

sana: run quality smoke on the fp16 fallback path before we make the fallback auto. we need to ensure no measurable quality regressions on our eval set (few-shot tasks + chat traces). I'll queue a perf/quality run across 200 prompts.

qa-bot: smoke-run complete: fp16 fallback passes our suite within 2% BLEU/perplexity delta on the subset. latency + token-cost increases ~6%, but stable (no OOM). Noted one generation truncation for very long (>512) prompts when max_new_tokens=512 — recommending default max_new_tokens=256 for int4 onboarding and doc note for users who need longer sequences.

ashley: ok agreed. action items: lower onboarding default max_new_tokens -> 256 for lyric7b-int4, enable runtime.kv_compact for canary, add auto-fallback to fp16 when mem_util>0.8, and file a followup to revisit prefetch strategy for long contexts (TICKET-4532). I'll open the PR for the defaults and release notes. :white_check_mark:

matt: thanks — i'll push the hotfix and monitor canary. will add metric alert if fallback rate > 5% in 10m. :mag:
